Title: LSJ - Votes during a Blood Hunt

Messages.Author: Andrew Rowanbranch
Messages.Body:
Hi there!

I was wondering about one thing, which votes are usable during the Blood
Hunt referendum?

Can cards that are in play (Powerbase: Madrid for example) be used to gain
votes, can the Edge be burnt for a vote and so forth?

Can I play cards from my hand that give me additional votes?
Can I play/discard a political card from my hand to gain a vote?

Thanks in advance
- Andrew

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Andrew Rowanbranch wrote:
>
> Hi there!
>
> I was wondering about one thing, which votes are usable during the Blood
> Hunt referendum?
>
> Can cards that are in play (Powerbase: Madrid for example) be used to gain
> votes, can the Edge be burnt for a vote and so forth?

The ones that aren't restricted to political actions (PB:Madrid and Ventrue HQ)
and the Edge and PA cards, and votes from ready vampires.

> Can I play cards from my hand that give me additional votes?

No. [6.5.6]

> Can I play/discard a political card from my hand to gain a vote?

Burn, yes. [6.5.6]
